Futures position sizing uses versioned contract references, integer tick and micro-dollar arithmetic, all-in estimated costs and user-entered remaining-loss caps. The current contract profiles remain unverified and no prop-firm program rules are verified.

Futures position size calculator

Use a listed contract family and micro/standard profile, then enter the exact contract code and expiry from your source. Estimates are conditional because the contract records are only partially source-reviewed; lifecycle and effective-date fields remain incomplete.

CONDITIONAL ESTIMATE · NOT EXECUTION

The records do not yet establish an active expiry, first-notice date, delivery window or effective period. Check the linked source for your exact contract and month before using the estimate. USD-only; no FX conversion, margin or liquidation estimate. Enter exact contract, expiry and cost assumptions to calculate a conditional estimate. Core tick facts are source-checked; the full contract record remains partial.

Tick value means dollars per exchange tick, not dollars per index point. Round-turn fees should include broker, exchange, clearing, NFA and routing costs. Spread and slippage are estimates supplied by you, not observed fills.
